name: Daystamp
description: Counts the days you spend in each country — privately, offline, right on your iPhone.
about: Digital nomads, expats and frequent travellers need to know how many days they've spent where: for tax residency (the 183-day rule), visas and the Schengen 90/180 rule. Daystamp keeps that count in the background, so you don't have to dig through tickets and passport stamps.
features: Counts the days in each country automatically, even with the app closed
Shows progress to your residency threshold (183 days by default) and warns you as you get close
World map of the countries you've visited and a year calendar coloured by country
Correct any day or add past trips by hand
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your current country and days
Back up your history to Files or iCloud Drive and restore it on a new phone
The country is worked out on your iPhone from built-in borders; coordinates are never stored
Pro: Schengen 90/180 calculator and trip planner, past years, threshold alerts and CSV export
price: Free, with optional Pro as a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
